name: Cocos Island National Park
description: Cocos Island is a small volcanic island about 550 km off Costa Rica's Pacific coast, home only to park rangers. It is the one island in the tropical eastern Pacific cloaked in true rainforest. The surrounding deep, current-swept waters draw divers from around the world to swim with hammerhead sharks, rays, tuna and dolphins. Reaching it takes a boat trip of 36 to 48 hours.
